summary_ja: KIOXIA GP1を、HBM代替ではなくGPU直接access可能なflash容量tierとして追加しました。2026年末の限定sample、1,000万IOPS仕様、2027年の1億IOPS・PCIe 7.0目標を分け、容量、latency、write、software、価格を未確認事項として残します。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds KIOXIA GP1 as a GPU-direct flash-capacity tier rather than an HBM replacement. It separates selected-customer samples by the end of 2026, the 10-million-IOPS specification, and the 2027 target for 100 million IOPS with PCIe 7.0, leaving capacity, latency, writes, software, and pricing unresolved. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

items.name_en: GP1 PCIe 6.0 sample targeting 10 million IOPS
items.timing_ja: 2026年末までに限定顧客へ評価sample予定
items.timing_en: Evaluation samples planned for selected customers by the end of 2026
items.statement_ja: KIOXIA GP1は第2世代XL-FLASH、PCIe 6.0、NVMe 2.2を用い、512 byte random readで最大1,000万IOPS、最大50 DWPDを掲げるGPU direct access向けSSDです。E3.SとE1.S 9.5/15 mmを予定し、一部form factorはcold-plate液冷、全形状はair coolingに対応するとしています。HBM/DRAMより低価格なflash容量tierをGPUから直接扱う構想ですが、2026年末は限定顧客向け評価sampleであり、一般販売ではありません。容量、read latency分布、random write、queue depth、GPU software stack、failure semantics、価格は公表資料だけでは確定しません。
items.statement_en: KIOXIA GP1 is a GPU-direct-access SSD using second-generation XL-FLASH, PCIe 6.0, and NVMe 2.2, with a stated maximum of 10 million 512-byte random-read IOPS and up to 50 DWPD. E3.S and 9.5/15-mm E1.S form factors are planned; selected forms support cold-plate liquid cooling and all are described as supporting air cooling. It is intended as a lower-cost flash-capacity tier directly accessible by GPUs, but the end-of-2026 milestone is an evaluation sample for selected customers, not general availability. Capacity, read-latency distribution, random-write behavior, queue depth, GPU software stack, failure semantics, and price are not established by the public material.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIでは大規模model、embedding、graph、sparse data、checkpoint restartのworking setをHBMへ常駐できない場合のtierとして、実効latencyとGPU idle削減を評価できます。
items.hpci_relevance_en: HPCI can evaluate the tier for models, embeddings, graphs, sparse data, and checkpoint-restart working sets that do not fit in HBM, using delivered latency and GPU-idle reduction.
adoption_conditions_ja: capacity、latency percentile、queue depth、read/write混在、endurance、powerをsampleで測定する。
GPU direct path、driver、filesystem/object API、memory allocator、error handlingを公開再現する。
HBM、DRAM、TLC SSDとの同一working setによるtime-to-solutionと総費用を比較する。
adoption_conditions_en: Measure capacity, latency percentiles, queue depth, mixed reads/writes, endurance, and power on samples.
Reproduce the GPU-direct path, drivers, filesystem or object APIs, memory allocator, and error handling publicly.
Compare time to solution and total cost against HBM, DRAM, and TLC SSD using the same working sets.

items.name_en: 2027 target for 100 million IOPS and PCIe 7.0
items.timing_en: Third-generation XL-FLASH and PCIe 7.0 targeted for 2027
items.statement_ja: Kioxiaは第3世代XL-FLASHとPCIe 7.0により1億IOPSを2027年に目指すroadmapを示しています。これはGP1の1,000万IOPS sampleから10倍のrandom-read IOPSを狙うvendor targetであり、製品名、lane数、controller数、容量、消費電力、host/GPU接続、sample/量産時期は確定していません。IOPSの増加だけでは、single-drive latency、application throughput、network越し共有、耐障害性は保証されません。
items.statement_en: Kioxia presents a roadmap targeting 100 million IOPS in 2027 with third-generation XL-FLASH and PCIe 7.0. This is a vendor target for ten times the random-read IOPS of the 10-million-IOPS GP1 sample; product name, lane and controller counts, capacity, power, host/GPU attachment, and sample or production timing are not fixed publicly. Higher IOPS alone does not establish single-drive latency, application throughput, shared access over a network, or fault tolerance.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 2027年目標をsystem設計へ使う場合は、PCIe 7 host availability、slot/retimer、cooling、software、複数drive集約を同じroadmapで追跡する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Using the 2027 target in system design requires tracking PCIe 7 host availability, slots and retimers, cooling, software, and multi-drive aggregation on the same roadmap.
adoption_conditions_ja: PCIe 7 host、switch、retimer、cable、form factorのsample時期を追跡する。
1億IOPSのblock size、read/write比、queue depth、drive数、power、冷却を確認する。
single-node memory tierとshared storageの責任分界、coherence、persistenceを定義する。
adoption_conditions_en: Track sample timing for PCIe 7 hosts, switches, retimers, cables, and form factors.
Confirm block size, read/write mix, queue depth, drive count, power, and cooling for 100 million IOPS.
Define responsibility boundaries, coherence, and persistence between a node-local memory tier and shared storage.
